name: Orc Camp · 9 Waves
_design: Journey of the Orc Camp zone (2026-11-21). Same schema as mummy_waves.json (wave_mode: ONE fight of 9 waves on one 16x9 board from arena_maps, the boss is wave 9, wave_heal_fraction 0 = no rest between waves). Family rule: orcs live ONLY here (orc_grunt, orc_archer, orc_mage, boss orc_warlock; tests/test_mummy_pyramid.gd derives the families from the data). The orc family has no knight, so each mummy-knight slot of the mummy journey is one more orc_grunt; otherwise the mummy ramp one to one: w1 grunts, w2 the archer, w3 grunts (the knight slot), w4 the mage, w5-w8 mixes, w9 the Orc Warlock (boss: true) with 2 grunts (x1.5 = 3). BOSS DECISION PENDING: is the finale a PAIR like the pyramid? For now the Warlock alone (see _tuning). Only one arena board exists (orc_camp_night); boss_map/camp_map point at it because logic/journey_data.gd requires valid ones (no separate rest/boss map).
blurb: ด่านเดียว 9 เวฟ ปิดท้ายด้วยจอมเวทออร์ค
